description: Returns a published catalog part and verified pins. Skip this call when search_parts already supplied the needed pins and facts. Use the selected catalog result’s id; returned pins[].number is the padId used in board connections. Use search_parts to find alternatives. factQuery and factOffset select or page cached datasheet facts. An optional boardRef applies that board’s strict Part List restriction, when enabled.

boardRef.description: Private board reference. For a new board generate 32 random bytes, encode as unpadded base64url, and prepend egbr1_. Keep this same value for creation retries and every later board operation. Copy returned references unchanged. Keep it in this conversation or supported private execution state; never put it in logs or source files. A private board link may carry it in its fragment.

factOffset.description: Continue at nextFactOffset with the same factQuery.

factQuery.description: Terms for relevant facts omitted from the supplied bundle.
